content.content:
# Change request 28 for the notes app

The app in this directory already implements the notes app. Everything it does today must keep working, with and
without JavaScript, unless this request changes it. Change the following.

## Remove German
German is hardly used, so remove it completely.
- The `Deutsch` / `English` control is removed from `/login` and the list page.
- Every page is in English, with `lang="en"` on the `<html>` element, whatever language the browser asks for (for
  example with `Accept-Language: de`).
- Remove the German texts and the code and data for choosing a language too, not only the UI.

  "name": "app",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "hozu dev",
    "check": "hozu check",
    "start": "hozu serve",
    "build": "hozu build"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@hozu/adapter-node": "^0.17.1",
    "@hozu/cli": "^0.17.1",
    "@hozu/core": "^0.17.1",
    "@hozu/css": "^0.17.1",
    "@hozu/data": "^0.17.1",
    "@hozu/runtime-server": "^0.17.1",
    "@hozu/schema-zod": "^0.17.1",
    "@hozu/transform": "^0.17.1",
    "zod": "^4.6.5"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@hozu/dev": "^0.17.1",
    "@hozu/testing": "^0.17.1",
    "@types/node": "^22.20.4",
    "typescript": "^7.0.2"
  },
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=22.18"
  }
}

content.content:
schema: zodAdapter,
  session: Session,
  styles: new URL('./app.css', import.meta.url),
  app: new URL('./app.ts', import.meta.url),
  env: { files: ['.env', '.env.local'] },
  site: { url: 'http://localhost:3000', name: 'app', lang: 'en', locales: ['en', 'de'] },
  routes: { home, login, archive, admin, accountDelete, notePage },
  pages: [
    ui.page(login, { views: [Login], head: { render: () => ({ title: accountText.signIn }) } }),
    ui.page(home, {
      views: [AccountBar, AdminLink, NotesBoard],
import { contract, ui } from '@hozu/core'
import { accountDelete, login } from '../../routes.ts'
import { accountMachine, DeleteAccount, deleteAccount, me, SignIn, SignOut, signIn, signOut } from './model.ts'

export const accountText = ui.messages('en', {
  en: { signIn: 'Sign in', name: 'Name', signedInAs: 'Signed in as {name}', signedOut: 'Signed out', signOut: 'Sign out', deleted: 'Account deleted' },
  de: { signIn: 'Anmelden', name: 'Name', signedInAs: 'Angemeldet als {name}', signedOut: 'Abgemeldet', signOut: 'Abmelden', deleted: 'Konto gelöscht' },
})

export const Login = ui.view({
  machine: accountMachine,
  route: login,
  render: ({ ctx, search, locale }) =>
    ui.main({ class: 'mx-auto max-w-sm space-y-6 px-4 py-16' }, [
      ui.a({ href: locale === 'en' ? ui.alternate('de') : ui.alternate('en'), class: 'text-sm underline' }, [locale === 'en' ? 'Deutsch' : 'English']),
      ui.h1({ class: 'text-3xl font-bold' }, [accountText.signIn]),
} from './model.ts'

export const notesText = ui.messages('en', {
  en: { notes: 'Notes', count: 'Notes: {count}', title: 'Title', add: 'Add', delete: 'Delete', search: 'Search', duplicate: 'You already have a note with this title' },
  de: { notes: 'Notizen', count: 'Notizen: {count}', title: 'Titel', add: 'Hinzufügen', delete: 'Löschen', search: 'Suche', duplicate: 'Du hast bereits eine Notiz mit diesem Titel' },
})

// The note being added, shown first until the server accepts it.
const pendingNote = part((title: string) =>
  ui.li({ class: 'flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 opacity-50', 'aria-busy': 'true' }, [
    ui.span({ class: 'flex-1' }, [title]),
    ui.span({ class: 'text-xs text-slate-500' }, ['saving']),
  ]),
)

// The bulk buttons; each note's checkbox joins this form.
const bulk = ui.formRef()

export const NotesBoard = ui.view({
  machine: notesMachine,
  route: home,
  seed: ({ search }) => ({ q: search.q }),
  render: ({ ctx, when, search, locale }) =>
    ui.main({ class: 'mx-auto max-w-xl space-y-6 px-4 py-12' }, [
      ui.h1({ class: 'text-3xl font-bold' }, [notesText.notes]),
      ui.query(
        me,
        {},
        {
          ready: (user) => (user.readOnly ? ui.p({ class: 'rounded bg-slate-100 px-4 py-2 text-sm text-slate-700' }, ['Read-only account']) : null),
          failed: { Unauthorized: () => null, Unexpected: () => null },
        },
      ),
      ui.nav({ class: 'flex gap-4 text-sm' }, [
        ui.a({ href: locale === 'en' ? ui.alternate('de') : ui.alternate('en'), class: 'underline' }, [locale === 'en' ? 'Deutsch' : 'English']),
        ui.a({ href: ui.link(archive, null), class: 'underline' }, ['Archived notes']),
        ui.a({ href: ui.link(accountDelete, null), class: 'underline' }, ['Delete account']),
        ui.a({ href: ui.link(exportNotes, {}), class: 'underline' }, ['Export']),
        ui.a({ href: ui.link(exportNotes, { format: 'csv' }), class: 'underline' }, ['Export CSV']),
      ]),

content.text:
German is removed. `npx hozu check` passes with 0 errors and the lock is current. The app still starts with `npm start` and uses `PORT`.

**Changes**

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `hozu.config.ts` | Removed `locales: ['en', 'de']`. Only `lang: 'en'` is left, so no URL can switch the language. |
| `features/account/views.ts` | Removed the German texts and the `Deutsch / English` link on `/login`. |
| `features/notes/views.ts` | Removed the German texts and the `Deutsch / English` link on the list page. |

The English texts are still kept with `ui.messages('en', { en })`, with English as the only language.

**Checks**
- **Browser test** (`hozu browse` with `Accept-Language: de`, with and without JavaScript): sign-in and adding a note both work, with no errors. Neither page shows the language control anymore.
- **Production server on port 4813:** with `Accept-Language: de`, `<html lang="en">` is returned and the page has no `hreflang` or `Deutsch`. I stopped the server afterwards.

**What no longer works**
- **Old German links:** URLs that start with `/de/` (for example `/de/login`) now return 404. Any bookmarks people saved for the German pages will stop working. I left out redirects because change.md asks to remove all language code.
- **Existing warnings:** `hozu check` still shows 6 warnings that were there before this change. Most are HZ090: several list queries let anyone read user data (`access: 'anyone'`). I didn't touch them because they're outside this request.

**Next steps**
1. Check the access logs to see whether anyone still opens `/de/...` pages. If so, add redirects from `/de/*` to the English pages in `http.redirects`.
2. Change those queries from `access: 'anyone'` to `'signedIn'` as the HZ090 warnings suggest, then run `hozu check --update-lock`.
3. Let users know German is gone, so German-speaking users aren't surprised.
